_help: Tier 4, entanglement-based BBM92 (spontaneous parametric down-conversion source of polarization-entangled pairs near 810 nm, polarization analyzers at both sites, silicon single-photon detectors, a time tagger). Each 'pulse' is one Site A detection; Site B's collection and detection efficiency is detector_efficiency; accidental coincidences in the coincidence window play the role of dark counts; imperfect entanglement visibility V appears as misalignment_error = (1 - V)/2 (here V = 0.94). The post-processing is the same as BB84's [bennett1992bbm92]. The alert level is set from this setup's own baseline (about 3 %), at 5 %.
